candidate_manifest_lineage.description: Frozen candidate-to-manifest lineage for all 24 selected candidates from the step-2 v2 binding. Native outcome fields are intentionally absent (not_produced); no outcome value was fabricated, inspected, or substituted.

claim_boundary: inconclusive only. This is not benchmark evidence, calibrated failure probability, cross-planner transfer, planner-performance evidence, or paper/dissertation evidence. Archive-nearness remains diagnostic only and was not substituted for the outcome endpoint.
decision_reasons: fail_closed_independent_outcomes_unavailable: no producer harness exists in the repository for adversarial_independent_outcomes.v2; the runner only consumes the packet. Producing native rows requires an execution orchestrator whose committed location is outside the lease allowed_paths (robot_sf and scripts/adversarial are forbidden). compute_submit was not authorized for this lease. Per the frozen outcome contract fail_closed_conditions and decision_rule, unavailable native outcomes yield inconclusive.

underpowered_for_minimally_important_effect: at the frozen budget of 12 candidates per arm the two-sided Fisher-exact boundary minimum detectable yield difference is 0.416667, above the 0.20 minimally important absolute yield improvement, so powered=false and the decision is inconclusive regardless of any native outcome sign or count.
evidence_boundary: Public-safe: only repository-relative paths, content-addressed SHA-256 digests, frozen decision predicates, and the runner decision function output are recorded. No host names, credentials, scheduler internals, or sensitive artifact locations.

exclusions_verified.rule: the five classic_cross_trap_medium / goal archive records are excluded from fit, candidate selection, threshold setting, and result interpretation

native_outcome_production_status.fail_closed_rule: frozen outcome_contract.fail_closed_conditions + decision_rule: unavailable/mismatched/fallback/degraded/lineage-incomplete native outcomes => inconclusive
native_outcome_production_status.orchestrator_location_blocked: lease immutable allowed_paths = [docs/context/evidence/issue_3275_same_planner_held_out, docs/context/INDEX.md, scripts/validation/evidence_registry_baseline.json]; no code location is allowed, and robot_sf + scripts/adversarial are forbidden.
native_outcome_production_status.planned_executions_note: 24 selected candidates x (1 deterministic replay + 5 independent confirmation seeds) = 144 native social_force executions predeclared by the step-3 run plan
native_outcome_production_status.producer_harness_finding: grep over robot_sf/ and scripts/ shows adversarial_independent_outcomes.v2 is referenced only by the consumer module (robot_sf/adversarial/independent_outcomes.py), the preflight module (robot_sf/adversarial/held_out_preflight.py), and the runner (scripts/adversarial/run_proposal_vs_random_issue_2921.py). No code emits v2 outcome rows from native planner execution.

plain_language_summary: Step 3 of the #3275 same-planner held-out campaign. The frozen decision is INCONCLUSIVE. Native social_force outcome rows could not be produced because no code in this repository emits the adversarial_independent_outcomes.v2 packet from native planner execution (the step-3 runner only consumes such a packet), and the lease immutable contract permits no committed location for an execution orchestrator. Under the frozen fail-closed rule, unavailable native outcomes yield inconclusive. This is independently guaranteed by the frozen predeclared underpowering: at 12 candidates per arm the Fisher-exact boundary minimum detectable yield difference is ~0.417, above the 0.20 minimally important effect, so the design can never support continue or stop on this budget.
residual_risks: Native social_force outcomes were not produced; the frozen fail-closed rule (not the executed-outcome path) drives the inconclusive decision.

Producing native outcome rows requires an execution harness that is outside this lease's immutable allowed_paths; until such a harness exists and is run, the executed-row acceptance criteria of issue #6105 remain unmet.

Even with a future executed-outcome packet, the frozen k=12 budget is underpowered for the 0.20 minimally important effect, so the decision would remain inconclusive unless the budget is changed through a new contract (out of scope here).
